name: How do I know if a contractor will really finish the job after they start?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a contractor will really finish the job after they start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for signs of capacity: active project management, realistic scheduling, clear communication, and references that speak to follow-through. A contractor with a strong closeout process is more likely to finish punch-list items, warranty tasks, and final documentation on time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check capacity, communication, references, and closeout process before hiring. Finishing well depends on follow-through, not just starting strong.
